Is Maenam a good place to stay? | Yes, if you want quiet, value and a long beach. It has the cheapest beachfront rooms on Samui (mid-range about 1,000–2,500 THB), easy parking and the Pralarn ferry pier. It is 25–30 minutes from Chaweng and the nights are quiet.
Can you swim at Maenam Beach? | Yes, the sea is usually calm from January to September. The edge is shallow, then it reaches chest depth about 5 m out, so watch small children. High tide narrows the beach, and on windy days from October to December it gets choppy.
Is there still a Maenam walking street on Thursdays? | We have not confirmed it for 2026. A careful 2025 source says the Thursday walking street in Maenam Chinatown disappeared after the pandemic, while older listings still show it. J&J Street Food opposite the Chinese gate runs daily from about 12:00 to 24:00.
Where is the Koh Samui immigration office? | In Maenam, at 333 Maenam Road, Soi 1, Moo 1 (it moved from Nathon in 2016). Phone +66 77 423 440; usually open Monday–Friday 08:30–16:30, so call ahead. A 30-day extension costs 1,900 THB.
Which ferries leave from Maenam? | Lomprayah uses the Pralarn pier in Maenam: about three boats a day to Thong Sala on Koh Phangan (about 30 minutes, 350–400 THB), a slow ferry to Koh Tao (550 THB) and an 08:00 service towards Koh Nang Yuan. Check timetables the day before.
How far is Maenam from Chaweng? | About 15 km, or 25–30 minutes by car. Grab costs roughly 200–350 THB; a daytime songthaew costs about 50–60 THB for locals and 70–100 THB for tourists.
Is Maenam good for families? | For families with children who can swim, yes: it is quiet, cheap and calm in the dry season. With toddlers, be aware of the drop to chest depth a few metres out; Choeng Mon or nearby Ban Tai at high tide are gentler.
Is Maenam too quiet? | For nightlife lovers, yes: evenings are beach bars and early nights, apart from the Cape Away Sunday party. Fisherman's Village is 10–15 minutes away and Chaweng 25–30 minutes, so many people stay in Maenam and go out elsewhere.
